form for each, and the navigation.

6412.docs: The same, leaving out rules that have to read other records, for checking every row of a list.

1453.name: actions
1453.docs: The actions it brings. Asked once.

5304.name: entities_from_source

4196.name: AuditedObjectSpace
4196.docs:
A unit of work that writes what it commits to the audit trail, in the same commit, so a change
and its trail stay or go together. Changes made to the database some other way are not seen.

1653.name: hint
1653.docs: What the form says under it.

1980.name: focus_order
1980.docs:
The fields its form goes through first with the keyboard, in this order. The form shows
them in the same order, so the eye and the keyboard go the same way.

1072.name: required_operation
1072.docs: What it does to the records of its view, if it said.

4596.name: role_from_records
4596.docs: A role as its records say, with everything it has.

5250.name: environment
5250.docs: What expressions about this person are evaluated with.

3815.name: add
3815.docs: Marks this as a new record. A numbered key left at zero gets the next number.

4142.name: writer
4142.docs: Writes what was noted outside a commit, as nothing else is on the way for it.

6231.name: information
6231.docs: It goes on, with a note on the field.

2580.name: set_job_waker
2580.docs: Wakes whoever shows the frame, from any thread, when background work has something to show.

1145.name: Tint
1145.docs: A color with a meaning, which every theme has its own version of.

4669.name: as_seen
4669.docs:
A waiting change as the person can see it: what they cannot read goes empty, as a save fills it
in from storage for the commit.

1472.name: controller
1472.docs: What gives an application its behavior: controllers bring actions and react to views.

1672.name: is_custom
1672.docs: Whether the model added it: it comes with what it holds, which a declared one does not need.

1999.name: list_editable
1999.docs: People can change values right on its list, with the rules checked as they do.

2072.name: get
2072.docs: The value of a field; nothing is `Null`.

4815.name: PermissionPolicy
4815.docs: What a role says about what no permission mentions.

1618.name: autofocus
1618.docs: Takes the keyboard when its form opens.

837.name: message
837.docs: Tells people something, as long as whoever shows the application listens.

2018.name: strip_calculated
2018.docs: The object as it is stored, with no calculated values.

2545.name: new
2545.docs:
A frame with no view, with these controllers. Window controllers turn on now, if
the context fits them, and stay on.

2872.name: Diff
2872.docs:
A difference over the layers below it, as JSON: an object is a node, by id, and anything else
is a setting.

```json
{ "Views": { "Account_ListView": { "Columns": { "opening": { "Index": -1 } } } } }
```

A node that this difference itself creates has `"$new": true`.

2.name: REASON_SELECTION
2.docs: The reason an action is off because of what is selected.

656.name: Object
656.docs:
A record: its entity's name and a value per field. Dynamic, so filters, rules and
permissions read every entity the same way.

1964.name: state_machines
1964.docs: The states its records go through.

4380.name: UserDirectory
4380.docs: The people who can sign in, kept as records.

6469.name: start
6469.docs: Where a new record has to start; nothing means any state.

4580.name: SECURITY_ACTION_PERMISSION
4580.docs: What a role says about an action.

1056.name: accessible_name
1056.docs:
What screen readers call it, instead of its caption: for a caption that only makes sense
on the screen, such as an arrow.

3472.name: View
3472.docs: A view of the model, by its id.

5561.name: is_modified
5561.docs: Whether anything waits for a commit.

602.name: ActionResult
602.docs: What the running of an action asks for next, by whoever shows the application.

4453.name: is_empty
4453.docs: Whether nobody can sign in yet, so the first person has to be created.

2237.name: entity
2237.docs: The entity it shows; a dashboard has none.

2564.name: set_view
2564.docs:
Changes the view. Asked while a change is under way, as from a controller turning on,
it happens after that one ends.

2891.name: layers
2891.docs: Layers of differences over the generated model.

4199.name: new
4199.docs: Over this, writing to this trail.

4526.name: set_password_of
4526.docs: An administrator gives someone a password, which they have to change when they sign in.

1656.name: lookup_filter
1656.docs:
For a reference: what its records have to meet, where `?field` is the value of that field
of the record being edited, as in `[flow] = ?flow`.

2637.name: environment
2637.docs: What an expression is evaluated with: the language and what was added to it.

421.name: ViewInfo
421.docs: A view, as the model describes it.

4272.name: Credentials
4272.docs: What someone gave to sign in.

1075.name: accessible_name_text
1075.docs: What screen readers call it, when it is not its caption.

3818.name: Query
3818.docs: What to read: a filter, an order and a page.

5907.name: Equals
5907.docs: The field holds exactly the text.

6234.name: check
6234.docs: Says what is wrong with how it was declared.

5326.name: MissingKey
5326.docs: The object has no key yet.

2129.name: remove
2129.docs: Forgets what is kept under this key.

3110.name: ModelLayers
3110.docs:
The generated model and the layers over it. Taking a setting off a layer brings back what
the layer below says.

2002.name: form_columns
2002.docs: How many columns its form's fields go in.

4091.name: Line
4091.docs: One line of the trail, before it is written.

2402.name: PendingView
2402.docs: A view waiting for its turn, with the unit of work to take on, if a new one.

1621.name: none_caption
1621.docs: For a reference that can be left empty and is picked from a list: what empty is called.

5799.name: was_restored
5799.docs:
Whether [`Self::stored_in`] found records kept from before, so an app can put its first
records in only once.

3256.name: FileStore
3256.docs: A difference in a file. A failure while saving leaves the old file whole.

1040.name: is_background
1040.docs: Whether its work runs away from the screen.

3456.name: view_controllers
3456.docs: New controllers for a frame; each frame has its own.

2875.name: generate
2875.docs: The lowest layer of the model, from the entities.

5.name: REASON_SECURITY
5.docs: The reason permissions turned an action off.

1640.name: key
1640.docs: Makes it the key: read-only, and out of lists and forms unless told otherwise.

1967.name: Reminder
1967.docs: The field of a record that says when to remind people of it, and what to say.

2294.name: Lookup
2294.docs: A window to pick a record.

1840.name: editor
1840.docs: The way it shows its records, by the name of a list editor; nothing means what the list uses.

1059.name: assign

3475.name: DashboardContent
3475.docs: What a piece of a dashboard shows.

5564.name: refresh
5564.docs: Throws away every change and reads again from storage.

2694.name: job
2694.docs:
Work an action does away from the screen: it runs on a thread of its own, says how far it got,
can be stopped, and hands back the records it changed, which the frame keeps on the screen's
thread.

6218.name: new
6218.docs: A rule about the whole record.

1259.name: AppearanceContext
1259.docs: Which views a rule applies in.

478.name: ChoiceItem
478.docs: One option of a single-choice action, which can hold others.

6418.name: Transition
6418.docs: A way from one state to another.

2894.name: Administrator
2894.docs: What the administrator of an installation set.

5310.name: source
5310.docs:
Entities read from Rust source while the program runs: the structs and enums that would
derive `BusinessObject` and `BusinessEnum`, read by the same code the derives use.

351.name: Root
351.docs: Only a view of its own window.

6291.name: decimal
6291.docs: Before decimals, where a message shows money.

1659.name: non_cloneable
1659.docs: Stays behind when a record is cloned.

2640.name: Save
2640.docs: Keep this record, new or changed.

1078.name: is_active
1078.docs: Whether it is in place. If not, it is not shown.

4929.name: Condition
4929.docs:
An expression a permission depends on. One that does not read, or that fails on a record, never
allows and always denies, so a mistake in it cannot open anything.

5256.name: can
5256.docs: Whether they can do this to this record or, with none, to some record of the entity.

297.name: form_actions
297.docs: A place on its form for the actions of `ActionCategory::InForm` with this name.

4148.name: write_with
4148.docs: Writes notes there right away, instead of with the next commit.

5910.name: StartsWith
5910.docs: The field starts with the text.

1605.name: name
1605.docs: Its name, in expressions and in the model.

2586.name: prepare_popup
2586.docs: Fills in the record the form of the open popup starts with.

824.name: Frame
824.docs:
Where a view lives: it holds the view, the controllers that fit it, their actions and a
unit of work. A handle, so controllers and actions can keep one.

Changing the view tells whoever watches, turns off the controllers that were on, changes the
view, turns on those that fit the new one, and tells again.

1478.name: Money
1478.docs: Money, in whole cents, so it is always exact.

5329.name: DuplicateKey
5329.docs: Another record already has this key.

5656.name: select
5656.docs: Filters, sorts and takes the page of records as they are, computed or not.

3894.name: record_action
3894.docs:
Actions declared as data: on the records selected, they set fields to expressions, check the
rules and keep what passes. No code runs but the expressions.

3113.name: new
3113.docs: Layers over this generated model, all empty.

2005.name: state_appearance
2005.docs: An appearance that holds while its field is in this state.

3840.name: check
3840.docs:
Says what is wrong with it on this entity: an expression that does not parse, or a field
it has not.

5602.name: touches
5602.docs: Whether anything waits for this entity.

1624.name: aggregated
1624.docs: For a collection: its records belong to this one, and are cloned with it.

5802.name: persist
5802.docs: Writes every record to the storage, if there is one, and remembers what went wrong.

1043.name: target_entity
1043.docs: Only on views of this entity.

3459.name: update_generated
3459.docs: Changes what was generated, once every module added its part.

3659.name: unusable
3659.docs: What in the layers has nowhere to go.

6075.name: Error
6075.docs: It stops what was being done until it is fixed.

2551.name: set_security
2551.docs:
Turns actions off by what this person can do. What protects records is the secured space;
this is what keeps people from reaching for what would be refused.

2878.name: add_custom_fields
2878.docs:
Gives every view of an entity the fields the layers added to it, where it has not said
otherwise: a column at the end of its list, and a place on its form with the other simple fields.

2751.name: progress
2751.docs: How far it got, from 0 to 1, and what it is doing now.

1643.name: default_property
1643.docs: Makes it what names a record, for [`EntityInfo::default_property`].

1970.name: editor_settings
1970.docs: What the list editors are told about this list: an editor's settings node, and in it names and values.

535.name: Popup
535.docs: Opens a view in a window, and runs on OK.

4386.name: WrongCurrent
4386.docs: The current password given is not right.

6475.name: start
6475.docs: Where a new record starts, which also is what it starts with.

408.name: view_id
408.docs: Only the view with this id.

6348.name: Violation
6348.docs: A rule that was not met.

1062.name: on_executing
1062.docs: Asked before it runs; false stops it.

4459.name: has_active_administrator
4459.docs: Whether someone active is left who can do everything, in what this space holds.

6221.name: required
6221.docs: The field has to have something in it.

481.name: new
481.docs: An option with nothing under it.

1335.name: when
1335.docs: For records this says yes to.

1662.name: accepted
1662.docs: For a file: the extensions offered, such as `pdf`.

1989.name: navigation
1989.docs: The group it goes under in the navigation.

1081.name: enabled_reasons
1081.docs: Why it can or cannot be used.

4605.name: visible
4605.docs:
The record as they can see it; nothing if they cannot see it at all. A field of theirs
keeps its value only if it can be read on this very record.

3170.name: id
3170.docs: What it is known by among the nodes beside it.

5259.name: depends_on_record
5259.docs: Whether what they can do with this entity changes from record to record.

5132.name: object_permission
5132.docs:
Says this about these operations on the records an expression holds for. `?CurrentUserId`
and `?CurrentUserName` are the person. It comes before what is said about the whole entity.

827.name: ObjectSpace
827.docs:
A unit of work over records: what it reads includes its own changes, and nothing
reaches storage until [`commit`](Self::commit). A view has one of these, so canceling a
form throws away only that form's changes.

5659.name: Merged
5659.docs: What comes of putting together what a person changed and what someone else kept meanwhile.

2135.name: MemoryAttachmentStore
2135.docs: Files that last as long as the program, as on the web with no server.

3116.name: clear
3116.docs: Takes the setting off this layer, so the one below answers again.

2008.name: editor_setting
2008.docs:
Tells a list editor something about its list, as `ChartSettings`, `Kind` and `Line`. It goes
in the model under the list's view, so a person can change it like any other setting.

5859.name: current
5859.docs: Stored records with this space's changes on top, by key.

3643.name: entities
3643.docs: As the model has them now.

3970.name: CreationOnly
3970.docs: Only that a record was created, as when bringing in a lot of records.

2862.name: cell
2862.docs: A cell of a CSV line, quoted when it has to be.

5605.name: insert
5605.docs: Marks a record as new, refusing a key in use. `exists` says whether storage has it.

1627.name: group
1627.docs: The titled group it goes in on a form, away from the other fields.

1954.name: name
1954.docs: Its name, in the model and in code.

1500.name: entity
1500.docs: What a record is: its fields, what they hold and where they show.

3589.name: control
3589.docs: Shows a control the application registered, by its name.

2808.name: action
2808.docs: The id of the action that started it.

1046.name: nesting
1046.docs: Only on root views, or only on nested ones.

4570.name: password
4570.docs: Keeping passwords so that what is kept does not give them away.

3462.name: Module
3462.docs:
A part of an application: what it adds, in one place. Modules stack, each over those it
depends on.

5551.name: on_event
5551.docs: Calls this when something happens to the space.

592.name: accept_popup
592.docs: Ends the open popup with OK, which runs its action.

3662.name: export_captions
3662.docs:
What people see in the model, for translating outside the code: a line per caption, as CSV
with its path, the caption and an empty column for the translation.

1900.name: ListFilter
1900.docs: A filter ready for people to pick from a menu on a list.

6078.name: Severity
6078.docs: How much not meeting a rule matters.

2881.name: add_dashboard
2881.docs: Adds a dashboard to a model: its view, and its place in the navigation if it has one.

11.name: Reasons
11.docs:
Why something is on or off: pairs of reason and answer. It is on only if every answer is yes,
so one part of the application turning it off cannot be undone by another.

2754.name: save
2754.docs: Keeps this record, new or changed.

1646.name: in_detail
1646.docs: Whether it is on the form.

1973.name: list_criteria
1973.docs: What every record its list shows has to meet.

6151.name: IsTrue
6151.docs: The field is true, as with an agreement.

2954.name: to_json
2954.docs: Writes it as JSON text, ready for people to read.

1846.name: editor
1846.docs: Shows its records with the list editor of this name.

6351.name: is_error
6351.docs: Whether it stops what was being done.

6224.name: matches
6224.docs: The field has to match this regular expression.

1138.name: encoded
1138.docs: Puts a value in an address, where it cannot change what the address means.

1665.name: display_format
1665.docs:
How its value shows when it is not being edited: `{}` is the value, `{:.2}` a number with
these decimals, and `{:dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm}` a date.

1992.name: rule
1992.docs: Appends something its records have to meet.

230.name: TrueForAll
230.docs: All of them have to meet it.

6824.name: live_expose
6824.docs: Registers this crate's types with a playground's interpreter (feature `live`).

1084.name: check
1084.docs: Says what is wrong with how it was declared.

4608.name: over_stored
4608.docs:
What is written over what is stored: every field changed has to be theirs to write, before
and after, and a field they cannot read written back empty stays as it was. Nothing changed
means nothing to write, as writing it would bring back the whole record as it stood.

3827.name: enabled
3827.docs: An expression every record selected has to meet for it to be on.

5135.name: action_permission
5135.docs: Whether this action exists for it, by its id. A denied one goes away, whatever else says.

4027.name: audit
4027.docs: A record of who changed what, written in the same commit as the change.

5335.name: Denied
5335.docs: The person signed in cannot do this.

3119.name: merged
3119.docs:
The model, from the bottom up. What finds no node goes to the unusable list, and stays
in its difference.

2011.name: key_field
2011.docs: The field that identifies a record.

1630.name: predefined
1630.docs: For text: the values offered to pick from.

3719.name: entity
3719.docs: Adds an entity outside any module.

4573.name: SECURITY_USER
4573.docs: The entity of the people who can sign in.

6208.name: field
6208.docs: The field it is about, where the error shows.

3011.name: UnusableNode
3011.docs:
A part of a difference that has no node to land on, as after the entity it
refers to is gone. It is kept, and comes back into use if the node does.

6535.name: message
6535.docs: The field that says what it is about; nothing means what names the record.

3665.name: set_typed_setting
3665.docs:
Keeps a setting typed as text in the person's own layer, and applies it. It stays what it
was: a number has to be typed as a number, and yes or no as `true` or `false`.

1903.name: new
1903.docs: A filter that lets everything through, as the choice that takes the others off.

6408.name: message_part
6408.docs: What `{name}` in a message stands for.

2884.name: on_form
2884.docs:
The form's layout: simple fields in a group, in two columns when there are many; fields
that take the height they need in a group of their own; one list in a group, several in tabs.
The fields of its form, those of its focus order first and in that order.

4519.name: with_denied_message
4519.docs: What people are told when something is refused.

1649.name: editor
1649.docs:
The control that edits it, by name: `Segmented` for options side by side, or one
registered in an editor registry.

1976.name: checks_on_leave
1976.docs: A form says what is wrong with a field as it is left, and not only on saving.

6154.name: UniqueTogether
6154.docs: No other record holds the same in all these fields together.

6481.name: check
6481.docs:
Whether the record can make this change: to be called with the record as storage has it, or
nothing if it is new, and as it is about to be.

4265.name: MIN_PASSWORD_CHARS
4265.docs: The shortest password taken, in characters.

2503.name: Job
2503.docs: A job that started, as the screen sees it. A handle: the frame keeps one while it runs.

1068.name: confirmation_text
1068.docs: The question to ask before it runs.

1395.name: enabled
1395.docs: Whether it can be used, if a rule said.

1722.name: Server
1722.docs: As they are needed, a chunk at a time, for lists too long to read at once.

6227.name: target_criteria
6227.docs: Applies only to records that meet this.

1468.name: actions
1468.docs: The actions it brings. Asked once.

5192.name: name
5192.docs: Their name, for `?CurrentUserName` and the audit trail.

1668.name: secret
1668.docs:
Keeps it from everyone: a secured space never gives it out or takes it in, and no screen
shows it, as with what is kept for a password.

1995.name: list_criteria
1995.docs: What every record its list shows has to meet.

5592.name: key_text
5592.docs: A key as text, the same for equal keys.

1614.name: default_value
1614.docs: What a new record starts with.

3576.name: name
3576.docs: Its name, which its view's id starts with.

52.name: into
52.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

1033.name: popup
1033.docs: Opens a view in a window, and runs on OK.

3122.name: save
3122.docs: Writes this layer to a store.

2014.name: check
2014.docs: Says what is wrong with how it was declared.

2868.name: place
2868.docs: Writes a caption at this path of ids, making the nodes on the way.

1633.name: accessible_name
1633.docs: What screen readers call it, when the caption is not enough. The caption by default.

1960.name: Rule
1960.docs: One thing a record has to meet, in some contexts, and perhaps only when it fits.

6138.name: Required
6138.docs: The field has something in it.

4576.name: SECURITY_TYPE_PERMISSION
4576.docs: What a role says about a whole entity.

2814.name: take_changes
2814.docs: What it handed over since last asked.

1052.name: on_prepare
1052.docs: For a popup that opens a form: fills in the record it starts with.

5557.name: new_object
5557.docs: A record with what a new one starts with, kept only once [`save`](Self::save)d.

6211.name: target_criteria
6211.docs: It applies only to records that meet this.

3668.name: set_security
3668.docs: What every frame made from now on goes by, for who is signed in.

4322.name: Rejected
4322.docs:
The name, the password or the state of the account did not fit. It never says which, so
this cannot be used to find out who has an account.

2560.name: on_event
2560.docs: Calls this as the view changes.

6411.name: validate
6411.docs:
Checks a record against the rules of its entity that apply in this context. It does not
run by itself: forms call it before keeping, and anything else that writes calls it itself.

1452.name: scope
1452.docs: Which views it is for. Every one by default.

17.name: get
17.docs: The answer for a reason, if it was given.

4195.name: before
4195.docs: Each record as it was before this unit of work first touched it.

1652.name: autofocus
1652.docs: Takes the keyboard when its form opens.

1979.name: form_actions
1979.docs: Places on its form for actions, by the name of their `ActionCategory::InForm`.

6157.name: Exists
6157.docs: Some record of this entity meets this expression.

2633.name: functions
2633.docs: Functions an application adds to the criteria language, for everything that reads an expression.

1198.name: Layout
1198.docs: A group or a tab of a form.

417.name: view_id
417.docs: Only the view with this id.

4268.name: LOCKED_MINUTES
4268.docs: How long it waits, in minutes.

4595.name: rows_of
4595.docs: The rows of a table that belong to this role.

6230.name: warning
6230.docs: People are told, and can go on anyway.

4668.name: reaches_out
4668.docs:
Whether an expression reaches beyond the fields of the record, as a database could and memory
cannot: into a reference, or a collection.

1471.name: WindowController
1471.docs: Behavior tied to a window, whatever view it shows. Stays on while the frame lasts.

5322.name: UnknownEntity
5322.docs: There is no entity by this name.

1344.name: applies
1344.docs:
Whether it applies to this record. With no record, as for a whole column, only a
rule with no condition does.

1671.name: ModelNode
1671.docs: A node of the application model: an id, settings and nodes under it.

1998.name: checks_on_leave
1998.docs: A form says what is wrong with a field as it is left, and not only on saving.

890.name: Disabled
890.docs: It is shown but off, with the reasons.

3179.name: get
3179.docs: The node under it with this id.

5595.name: key_of
5595.docs: The key of a record, as text.

3833.name: id
3833.docs: Gives it an id of its own.

1617.name: wide
1617.docs: It takes the whole width of its group on a form.

5795.name: import_json
5795.docs:
Puts these records, as [`Self::export_json`] writes them, in place of all there are, and
keeps them if the database is stored. Returns how many there are. Nothing changes if
anything is wrong: an entity it does not have, a record without its key, a value that
cannot be read.

836.name: service
836.docs: Something the application gave its actions, by its type.

3252.name: StoredModel
3252.docs:
The person's own settings kept in a [`Storage`](ravenrs_core::Storage) under a name: a file on
the desktop, the browser's IndexedDB on the web, beside the records.

1036.name: url
1036.docs: Opens an address made from the selected record, where `{field}` takes its value.

3452.name: module
3452.docs: How an application is put together: modules bring entities, behavior and model changes.

2017.name: compute
2017.docs: Fills in the calculated fields, in the order declared, so one can read another.
